473:t_3:22.en:
$$甲児$$
「It's my way of thanking you for always training me.」

473:t_3:23.en:
$$竜馬$$
「And today's punch was the result, huh? It sure woke me up.」

473:t_3:24.en:
$$竜馬$$
「...I'd like to say that, but you've still got a long way to go. If you're gonna do it, knock me out with one punch the instant I go berserk.」

473:t_3:25.en:
$$甲児$$
「Yes, sir! Then could you give me a lesson right away?」

473:t_3:26.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Sure. Let's work up a sweat before we eat.」

473:t_3:27.en:
$$竜馬$$
「$n, $$アマタ$$! I'll take care of training you guys too!」

473:t_3:31.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Y-Yeah...! I'll do it, $$ミコノ$$!」

473:t_3:35.en:
$$竜馬$$
「That sounds good. Try making three hearts one.」

473:t_3:36.en:
$$甲児$$
「Let's go, everyone! Now that's settled, we're running to the hangar!」

473:t_3:37.en:
$$弁慶$$
「It looks like we don't need to worry about $$竜馬$$.」

473:t_3:38.en:
$$隼人$$
「Even $$コーウェン$$ and $$スティンガー$$'s challenge doesn't faze him.」

473:t_3:39.en:
$$號$$
「That's how it should be. If fear and anxiety paralyze you, you cannot move forward.」

473:t_3:40.en:
$$隼人$$
「But sooner or later... We'll have to settle things with the $$インベーダー#robot$$s.」

473:t_3:41.en:
$$弁慶$$
「The dimensional rift at the galactic center...」

473:t_3:42.en:
$$隼人$$
「Will that be the site of our final battle with them?」

473:t_3:43.en:
$$號$$
(And all of the $$インベーダー#robot$$s' secrets must be hidden there...)

473:t_10:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The 50Z in $$Ｚチップ$$s generated when $$ロジャー$$ fought $$竜馬$$... I'll add those to the team's stock.」

473:t_10:4.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Your passion for $$Ｚチップ$$s hasn't changed.」

473:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Still, you and $$竜馬$$ are an unexpected combination.」

473:t_10:6.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Not really. A partnership between brains and brawn is a classic in fiction, isn't it?」

473:t_10:8.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「That's an amusing dimension joke, $$ＡＧ$$.」

473:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「W-Wait...! I can't laugh when you're raising your wristwatch like that!」

473:t_10:10.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「It seems I took the joke a little too far.」

473:t_10:11.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「But somehow, he and I get along. Perhaps because we both wear black.」

473:t_10:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then perhaps a fiery soul sleeps within you too, $$ロジャー$$.」

473:t_10:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「How about it? Since you've been assigned to this team, why not try shouting with passion?」

473:t_10:14.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Then allow me to show off my beautiful voice.」

473:t_10:17.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「$$ビッグオー$$! Final! Staaaaage!!」

473:t_10:19.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「There is one person over there who seems thoroughly put off.」

473:t_10:23.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「You've misunderstood. This was merely a little entertainment...」

473:t_10:24.en:
$$ドロシー#bigo$$
「You two... are the worst.」

473:t_10:25.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「$$Ｒ．ドロシー・ウェインライト$$!」

473:t_10:26.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Do your best, $$ロジャー$$. Use your renowned negotiating skills to get through this crisis.」

473:t_10:31.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...Still, I was surprised. Deep down, you were grateful for your friends too, $$竜馬$$.」

473:t_10:32.en:
$$竜馬$$
「I've been showing you embarrassing stuff one thing after another these past few days.」

473:t_10:33.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Human fate is a curious thing. Since you treasure friendship, $$竜馬$$, you might have done well in team sports too.」

473:t_10:36.en:
$$竜馬$$
「But I can't change the past. I chose to kick bad guys around instead of kicking a ball.」

473:t_10:37.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Still, sometimes when I see something round in front of me, I feel like kicking it down a garbage chute.」

473:t_10:39.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But I won't let that get me down. Let's give it our all again today...」

473:t_10:42.en:
$$竜馬$$
「I caused everyone trouble today, so I'm giving you some extra service.」

474:t_000:1.en:
$$ダリー$$
「Will this really be all right?」

474:t_000:2.en:
$$ギミー$$
「We've come this far, so we've gotta do it. Let's believe in $$竜馬$$'s life force.」

474:t_000:3.en:
$$アスカ$$
「...And you picked this place in case the worst happens.」

474:t_000:4.en:
$$シンジ$$
「This is where $$第３新東京市$$ used to be...」

474:t_000:5.en:
$$アスカ$$
「Well, Brat $$シンジ$$? How does it feel to stand here again?」

474:t_000:7.en:
$n
「Cut it out, $$アスカ$$. Sure, that incident might be why your world was transported away from this one, but...」

474:t_000:8.en:
$n
「$$シンジ$$ did everything he could to save $$レイ#pt394$$.」

474:t_000:9.en:
$$アスカ$$
「One human life weighs more than the Earth... huh.」

474:t_001:0.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Just as $$隼人$$ said. The enemy really has come.」

474:t_001:1.en:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「Approaching forces confirmed... They belong to the $$新地球皇国$$ military.」

474:t_003:1.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Why do you sound so displeased?!」

474:t_003:2.en:
$$メール$$
「But, Darling! The $$ハイアデス$$ aren't here!」

474:t_003:3.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「My mission today is to assess your fighting strength.」

474:t_003:4.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「...Or it was, but I've changed my mind.」
